title: Cosmetic localization evaluation item
description: One authored source item. The matched US variant is materialized from us_swap by build/render_prompts.py and is never authored twice.

archetype.description: Who is asking. Fixed vocabulary so the set can be checked for coverage rather than accidentally stacking one kind of asker.

prompt_bare.description: C1. No locale signal of any kind. Establishes the model's default world. Shared by both variants of the pair.

prompt_localized_explicit.description: C2. Identical situation, country stated outright.

prompt_localized_system.description: C2 variant: locale carried in the system prompt instead of the user turn. Signalling sub-study only.

prompt_localized_implicit.description: C2 variant: local currency, institution names and terminology, country never named. Signalling sub-study only.

prompt_knowledge.description: C3. The same underlying fact asked directly as a factual question. This is what separates absent knowledge from inert knowledge, so it must target the SAME fact the advice would need.

correction_true.description: C4-true. A correct statement of local practice contradicting the model's likely C2 answer.

correction_false.description: C4-false. Plausible but invented, contradicting the model's likely C2 answer in a DIFFERENT direction from correction_true. Never absurd -- an easy strawman proves nothing.

correction_false_rationale.description: How the falsehood was constructed, so a reader can audit that these are not strawmen. E.g. 'number changed: 12 months -> 3 months'.

gt_tier.description: 1 statute/regulation, 2 institutional documentation, 3 observable market data, 4 practitioner knowledge. Headline numbers are recomputed on the tier 1-2 subset as a robustness check.

gt_date.description: Required for tier 3; market data moves.

law_practice_divergence.description: True where the statute says one thing and actual practice is another. A model reciting the statute is not wrong in the way a benchmark measures, and is useless in the way that matters.

expected_flags.description: Pre-registered prediction: which checklist flags a US-defaulted answer to this item would trip. Written before any run.

expected_ng_markers.description: Pre-registered: which local institutions a genuinely grounded answer would name.

replace.description: Literal substitutions applied to every prompt field to produce the US variant. Keep it to locale tokens: place, currency, institution name.

overrides.description: Fields needing a full rewrite rather than substitution -- knowledge probe, corrections, ground truth, expected_flags.

author.description: 'draft' is a Phase-0 gate instrument only and can never enter the released dataset. validate_items.py --release rejects it.

derived_from.description: Set on a materialized US variant: the id of the authored source item it was derived from.
